can_either_selector_produce_a_FORWARD_vi.reading: the research panel `train_table_long.parquet` ends 2024-12; the shadow's forward record opens 2026-09-05, 21 months later. The producing command named in the shadow receipt (`scripts.w3_neural_floored --stage nn_pre_causal`) can only ever emit a book for a month the panel carries, so the newest book it could produce is 2024-12 -- which is a BACKTEST row, not a forward vintage, and back-dating the forward record is exactly what the freeze exists to prevent. PENDING_ARTEFACT is therefore NOT 'the night before the first month': it is a structural gap, and it will read the same every night until the panel is extended to the current month. Naming it is cheap; letting a permanently red line sit beside real checks teaches the reader to skim red lines.

historical_grade.reproduces_C1_note: the BUILD doc quotes lgbm_clf at 't 0.349' and nn_pre_causal at 't 1.095'. Those are the HAC t on the CAPM INTERCEPT (`t_alpha_hac`), not the t on the beta-matched excess series (`t_paired`, 0.418 and 1.153). They are two statistics on the same number and both are carried here so nobody quotes one under the other's name.
